QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] Collecting New Spirits
QuestInfo.0: #p2041026# doesn't seem too bothered by the changes in the Clocktower Bottom Floor. Take a look around.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: #p2041026# is excited to collect spirits from the changed Clocktower Bottom Floor, but there are too many for him to handle alone.  Collect #o6230400# and #o7130010#'s spirits in #p2041026#'s spirit detector. \r\n
QuestInfo.2: You collected the spirits from the changed Clocktower Bottom Floor for #p2041026#. #p2041026# was happy to be the only ghost hunter to possess such rare spirits. \r\n

0.0: I'm actually pretty stoked about all of this. Think about it: it's my chance to collect a bunch of new spirits! But, I mean, I'm only one guy. I need someone to, you know, soften them up for me first.\r\n

yes.0: I'm most curious about the #r#o6230400##k and #r#o7130010##k monsters. Help me hunt some of them!\r\n

no.0: Don't give me that look. I'm sure you ask for favors ALL the time.

1.0: Did you get them all? Show me, show me! I need to see them with my own eyes!

yes.0: This is the best day of my entire ghosthunting life! Now all the other ghosthunters can stop laughing at me! Thanks!

default.0: I've gotta get those spirits! I've gotta!
